blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) will help persons deprived of liberty (PDLs) establish cooperatives that could provide them with jobs and sustainable livelihoods after their release, as part of efforts to improve their reintegration into society. BuCor Director General Gregorio Pio Catapang Jr. directed superintendents of operating prisons and penal farms to assist inmates in organizing and managing the cooperatives, which will operate like small and medium enterprises, the bureau said in a statement on Tuesday.
